title: Maneuver Assessment AI implementation and integration

data_suitability.local_dataset_findings: The local ESA challenge archive contains historical risk labels/features but no candidate burn actions or candidate outcomes. The trajectory-assessment export contains screening/event data, not validated executed maneuver outcome labels. No real maneuver-success dataset or validated before/after Pc observations were found in the inspected material.
data_suitability.dataset_provenance: Generated offline by backend/app/ai/maneuver_training.py from deterministic synthetic Cartesian states. Every label is produced by the existing app.services.conjunction.optimize_maneuver routine. All labels are simulated, not observed maneuver outcomes.

ml_objective.task: Regression surrogate used to rank the existing physically generated nonzero candidate burns.
ml_objective.ranking_rule: Eligible candidates are ordered by ascending model-predicted bounded two-body simulated closest-approach miss distance. The model does not generate new candidates or claim superiority over the existing optimizer.
ml_objective.not_the_task: This is not a collision-probability model, real maneuver outcome model, safety model, or optimizer discovery task.
ml_objective.label_generator: Existing bounded Earth two-body point-mass RK4 simulator with 5 s maximum sample spacing and local closest-approach refinement; simulator convergence checks remain active.
scenario_generation_assumptions: Synthetic primary TCA radius 6800–7400 km; speed within 0.2% of the configured two-body circular speed.
Synthetic relative TCA separation 0.1–20 km and orthogonal relative speed 0.001–0.02 km/s.
Burn leads cycle through 60, 300, 900, and 1800 seconds.
Each scenario cycles one magnitude from 0.005, 0.02, and 0.05 m/s; the existing simulator evaluates six RTN directions and a zero-burn baseline.
Zero-burn baseline rows are not model training candidates. Search-boundary minima are excluded from training and evaluation candidate rows.
ml_objective.preprocessing: No missing-value imputation or scaling. Inputs must be finite and pass event identity, state-vector, frame, unit, and UTC epoch checks; categorical RTN directions are one-hot encoded.

feature_schema.name: RTN direction radial +/−, along-track +/−, cross-track +/−
feature_schema.frame_epoch: direction label from existing candidate generator at burn epoch

model_artifact.model_name: ORION simulated two-body maneuver miss-distance ranker
model_artifact.estimator: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=160, max_depth=12, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=1.0, random_state=1501, n_jobs=1)

training_and_evaluation.split: Deterministic 60/20/20 split by independent scenario_id using seed 1501. Every candidate from one scenario remains in one partition. The estimator configuration was fixed; validation data were not used to tune against test results.

test_denominators.regression_metrics: 72 eligible nonzero candidate rows from 12 held-out scenarios.
test_denominators.ranking_metrics: 12 independent held-out scenarios, ranking the eligible candidate rows within each scenario.
test_denominators.baseline: One minimum-delta-v candidate selected in each of the same 12 scenarios; deterministic candidate order breaks ties.

baseline_comparison.baseline: minimum delta-v candidate; deterministic candidate order breaks ties
baseline_comparison.comparison: The learned model had higher mean held-out regret than the minimum-delta-v baseline (0.0591 km vs 0.0370 km). It did not demonstrate useful ranking improvement on this test set.
baseline_comparison.interpretation: Small synthetic evaluation only; not evidence about real maneuvers.

integration.backend_inference_path: backend/app/services/conjunction.py::optimize_maneuver calls app.ai.maneuver_ranker.score_candidates on the existing candidate set. The backend loads the persisted artifact, verifies SHA-256, scikit-learn runtime, model version, and feature schema, scores only nonzero candidate inputs, and attaches ranks only to candidates whose independent simulator result is a refined in-window minimum. Boundary candidates stay unranked.
integration.api: POST /api/conjunctions/{event_id}/maneuver resolves the requested screening_job_id and exact stored physical event before simulation. The response carries the screening job ID, event ID, nested model/version/score metadata, candidate scores, and source event/screening-job provenance.
integration.frontend: src/App.jsx ManeuverPage consumes the actual job-bound backend response, displays model/status/score meaning and limitation text, and renders each physical candidate's ML rank and predicted simulator miss-distance score. Unavailable scores render as unavailable, not zero.
integration.reports: backend/app/services/reports.py adds model identity, score meaning, event/job provenance, candidate ranks and predicted simulator miss distances to the job-bound maneuver PDF.
integration.failure_behavior: Missing or incompatible artifact, invalid event features, or inference errors return an explicit unavailable ML result. Physics candidate evaluation remains available independently if ML scoring fails.
integration.physical_constraints: Existing optimize_maneuver validation and candidate generation remain in place. The model does not alter impulses, propagation, closest-approach search, baseline comparison, Pc, or feasibility. Search-boundary candidates are not assigned model ranks.
integration.identity: Event identity comes from the authoritative stored screening job event; model provenance is tagged with that event ID and screening job ID. Existing frontend event/job selection-generation safeguards continue to apply to the complete response.

known_limitations_and_blockers: No historical real-world maneuver action/outcome data were found; all labels are generated by the existing simulator.

Held-out model performance is weak: negative R2, near-zero mean within-scenario Spearman, 25% top-1 agreement, and greater mean regret than the minimum-delta-v baseline. The current model should be treated as experimental display-only ranking, not a useful or validated recommendation.
Only 12 independent scenarios are in the held-out test set, so estimates are unstable and limited to this scenario generator.
The model cannot validate the two-body simulator because its labels come from that same simulator.
Covariance, Foster Pc, execution uncertainty, spacecraft control, propulsion, attitude, J2, drag, third-body effects, and operational feasibility are not modeled.
Actual browser interaction and live application service connectivity remain unverified.
